about.title: About the Dialogue
body: Seri Negara Dialogue is a national platform for thoughtful conversation on Malaysia’s journey — from Merdeka 70 towards Malaysia 100.
It brings together leaders, thinkers and citizens to reflect on our shared history, address contemporary challenges, and explore a more united and prosperous future.
about.ambitionBody: The first Dialogue is held in 2026. It is built to return each year, so the conversation accumulates rather than restarts.

theme.title: 2026 Theme
theme.name: Many Histories. One Future.
theme.body: How do we draw strength from our past, examine today’s realities, and build a stronger, more inclusive Malaysia for the next generation?
theme.quote: From the signing of our independence to the conversations that will shape our future, Seri Negara remains a home for the nation.
questions: What does shared prosperity mean when growth and wages have moved apart?
Which institutions still earn public trust, and what restores the ones that do not?
How does a plural society argue well in public?
What should a Malaysian born in 2026 be able to expect?

terms.title: Terms of Use
body: This website is published by the organising team of Seri Negara Dialogue to provide information about the event on 8 October 2026 and to accept registrations for it.
Programme details, speakers and timings may change before the event. Registration does not guarantee entry if capacity is reached or if the details given cannot be verified at the door.
Content on this site, including text and images, belongs to the organising entity unless otherwise credited. Links to other organisations are provided for reference and do not imply any partnership.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: The details you give when registering are collected by the organising team of Seri Negara Dialogue for one purpose: managing attendance at the event on 8 October 2026.

They are used to confirm your place, to plan seating and catering, and to contact you about this event. They are not sold, and they are not shared with third parties beyond what the venue requires for access.
You may ask for your details to be corrected or removed at any time by writing to the organising team.
